caption:
ChatGPT's Google Drive integration just matured: you can now browse your Drive directly from the Library, pull files into chats without uploading again, and keep Docs/Sheets/Slides open side by side while you work.

The catch: ChatGPT reads what you point it at. If you drop a stale brief or old pricing list, it will quote it confidently.

Save this if you're pulling documents into ChatGPT constantly. Comment: do you hand it confidential files?
